answer: Five endorsements from five established neighbors gate entry against mass fakes. Each epoch a pulse opens the window, and each neighbor endorses at most three. Endorsements stack as shale layers; two per cluster count as one. A public atlas maps endorsements, exposing rented-neighbor rings. Each endorsement costs 25 credits, so 1,000 fakes pay 1,000 × 5 × 25 = 125,000 against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 125 once, keeping its share.
